title: Perfect 10 Magazine December January 2000 Volume 2 Number 5 Jeremy McGrath
descriptionText: The product is the December January 2000 volume of Perfect 10 Magazine, featuring Jeremy McGrath. This illustrated magazine focuses on art and photography, catering to a male audience interested in artistic topics. Published in the United States in 2000, it showcases high-quality content in English, making it a desirable collectible for fans of art and photography.
